context.reason: Explanatory introduction or section heading; operative obligations are inventoried separately.

requirements.clause: A rules unit possesses the union of its members' keywords.
requirements.assertion: Actual eligible Lord Exultant/Infractors formation unions live member keywords; bodyguard models do not acquire CHARACTER.

requirements.clause: A model possesses only its own keywords.
requirements.assertion: Actual eligible Lord Exultant/Infractors formation unions live member keywords; bodyguard models do not acquire CHARACTER.

requirements.clause: A keyword-qualified unit rule matches if any member has the keyword.
requirements.assertion: Legally attach Lord Exultant and Infractors; unit-effect gate accepts CHARACTER/CHARACTERS/INFANTRY, rejects VEHICLE.

requirements.clause: A keyword-qualified model rule matches only that model's own keywords.
requirements.assertion: Real mixed-unit model-effect scope selects leader only for CHARACTER(S), all for INFANTRY, none for VEHICLE.

requirements.clause: A non-keyword rule matches only if the specified model or unit lacks that keyword.
requirements.assertion: Core non-keyword selector over real unit/model inventories: CHARACTER differs between attached unit and bodyguard model; INFANTRY/VEHICLE controls.

requirements.clause: A mixed-keyword unit is affected by unit rules matching any member keyword.
requirements.assertion: Legally attach Lord Exultant and Infractors; unit-effect gate accepts CHARACTER/CHARACTERS/INFANTRY, rejects VEHICLE.

requirements.clause: Attacks target a rules unit, not a keyword-selected member.
requirements.assertion: CHARACTER selector matches real attachment; shooting candidate retains attached-unit identity and visible bodyguard+leader models, not just matching leader.

requirements.clause: Model-keyword effects do not spill over to other models in a mixed unit.
requirements.assertion: Real mixed-unit model-effect scope selects leader only for CHARACTER(S), all for INFANTRY, none for VEHICLE.

requirements.clause: Comma, slash, and or keyword alternatives mean any listed keyword.
requirements.assertion: Comma/or parser and slash descriptor alternatives reach real mixed-unit target gate; any matching alternative succeeds, no-match alternatives fail.

requirements.clause: Adjacent required keywords form a conjunction.
requirements.assertion: AELDARI+INFANTRY succeeds, AELDARI+VEHICLE fails with actual unit keywords.

requirements.clause: Legacy unspecified model/unit keyword subjects refer to units.
requirements.assertion: Implicit CHARACTER and explicit CHARACTER unit compile to FRIENDLY_UNIT; resulting keyword gate accepts actual attachment. Core grammar input, not a native ability grant.

requirements.clause: Singular and plural spellings identify the same canonical keyword.
requirements.assertion: Legally attach Lord Exultant and Infractors; unit-effect gate accepts CHARACTER/CHARACTERS/INFANTRY, rejects VEHICLE.

requirements.clause: Unit composition constrains the number and type of member models.
requirements.assertion: Actual Infractor regular4/9 endpoints accepted; champion missing/doubled rejected; existing regular3/10 failures retained.

requirements.assertion: Retained Tactical Perfection assignment resolves exact Lord Exultant model, never bodyguard; physical weapon replacement controls retained. Enhancement effect itself is outside this identity clause.
